notes.title: Beloved Battleblock Theater getting a new Steam update after a decade
notes.notes:
Hearing about Battleblock Theater is my Ratatouille food critic moment. I haven't thought about it in nigh on a decade, but seeing Hatty Hattington's square head and crying eyes takes me back to a much simpler time. Games dared to be weird, colorful, and embraced couch co-op in a way modern PC games typically don't. Sure, you can find each of those elements across countless releases these days, but how often do all three come together as one? Just thinking about Battleblock Theater has me wanting to jump back in, so it's lucky then that there's a massive Steam discount and impending free update, isn't it?
Read the rest of the story...

Battleblock Theater trailer shows PC release was worth waiting a year for

notes.title: A BattleBlock Theater update for Steam IS COMING SOON????
notes.notes:
Calling all prisoner friends and feline security to return back to the theater! The show must go on, yes?

BattleBlock Theater is soon receiving a quality of life update here on Steam!

This free update will include:


 Enhanced rendering – no more crunchy compression and much higher resolution!
 Lightning fast frame rates, limited only by your monitor’s capability!
 Higher audio bitrates for delicious sound!
 Various bug fixes and overall enhancements, hooray!
 Support for more controller types!

These changes could only mean one thing, right? We are preparing BattleBlock Theater for a modern console release, oh happy day! Which ones? When? TBA! NYAHHH!

Before you get too busy saving Hatty, be sure to check out our recent Behemoth Roadmap announcement to learn about EVEN MORE updates coming to Behemoth games (like a Castle Crashers DLC!!!), and other important things like how chickens deal with traffic.

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam Update 1.4 (Mac Only)
notes.notes:
Hello Mac Users!

We recently got a few reports from BattleBlock Theater players who had updated to the new OS X El Capitan on Mac about getting a flash sprite error when attempting to load the game. BBT Steam Update 1.4 addresses this issue and players should now be able to load the game without getting this error.

Fixed: "Fatal error - Failed to load Flash Sprite shader" error no longer pops up for OS X El Capitan users. 

If you notice any significant changes to your gameplay experience after downloading Update 1.4, please connect with our support team here: http://support.thebehemoth.com

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam Update 1.3 (Mac Only)
notes.notes:
Happy Friday, Theater patrons! We just wanted to give all the Mac users a heads up about a small update we rolled out yesterday. 


Update 1.3 includes:

App icon added for Mac version
Supported Logitech controllers now work in either XInput or DirectInput mode


For players who had BattleBlock Theater Mac before Update 1.3, please reinstall the game for the icon to change. 

NOTE: If you are NOT using Steam Cloud, you may want to back up your local saves first so you don't delete all your progress.

The save file for BattleBlock Theater is called:
battleblocktheatersave

Which you can find by searching for the file in the Steam user directory.

If you need any additional help, please connect with our support team here: http://www.thebehemoth.com/support/ticket

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Happy Monday, Everyone!

Today, we're excited to bring you an update with a couple big changes in BattleBlock Theater. One of the additions could potentially affect over 143 million people -- according to the 2013 census of the Russian population. (Or even more since we're not accounting for those people who are learning or have learned the language living outside of the country!) Here's what we're looking at in BattleBlock Theater Update 1.2:


Russian Language Support 

We've been working on this for a while now and thank our Russian fans for their patience and continuous support. Еще раз большое спасибо за вашу поддержку!

Update to the Online Menu UI

This will improve searching and viewing different types of available online games.

Minor bugs fixes



We will continue working on ways to improve the game and we are grateful for your support & understanding. If you experience any unexpected issues after this update, please feel free to let us know in the forums or in a support ticket that you can create here: http://www.thebehemoth.com/support/ticket

Thanks again and happy holidays!

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hiya BBT Fans!

Thanks for your patience in waiting for Update 1.1.4! We've got a couple minor changes added in that will improve the game for players around the world:

Update 1.1.4

1) Fixed a stability issue in the level select area with Chinese subtitles.
2) Improved general stability based on end-user reporting.


If you have any concerns after installing this update, please send us a message through our Support Ticket system. 

Have a great day!

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam [Update updated]
notes.notes:
EDIT: Rolled back to Update 1.1.3


Hello everyone!

This morning we did another mini update (1.1.4) to BattleBlock Theater Steam after viewing some of the end-user reporting. However, we had to roll back to Update 1.1.3 due to an issue with Windows XP users after they had installed Update 1.1.4. We're looking into the issue now and how to resolve it. So stay tuned!


Thank you again for your patience. 'Til next time, goodbye!

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Patrons of the Theater!

We're continuously trying to improve the game in different areas so that we can increase the quality of the experience for everyone. The newest update should address issues that affected game play for some BBT players:

Update 1.1.3

1) Patched to prevent exploits where users were getting gems without earning them.
2) Improved stability for players completing some user-created playlists. 


Thanks for your continued patience and support!

notes.title: BattleBlock Theater Steam Update 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
It's been a week since we've launched BattleBlock Theater on Steam. Since the launch we've been reviewing all feedback and have come up with a short list of changes in our first update that we're calling Update 1.1

Here's the breakdown:


Fixed an issue where the Castle Crashers Knight Prisoner was not awarding for a small percentage of players who own both Castle Crashers and BattleBlock on Steam

Added an Off option for in-game Voice Chat, and made Off the Default. Players should check their settings as some may have changed!

Made a minor change to Press to Talk remapping functionality

Fixed an issue with players 3 & 4 not displaying in the clipboard screen during Cooperative Local Arena Play.


---

In the past week, we've heard some great things about the game we want to share. Here's what Eurogamer Italy has to say:

"I filmati di presentazione sono realizzati ottimamente e strappano più d'una risata, nonostante la storia non sia incredibile."

I don't know what it means but I think that last word is incredible. We'll take it Italy!

Also, a users review had this to say:

"I got this game for $10 during the launch sale, and I highly recommend it at that price. It's no "Super Meat Boy", but I don't think we'll see a game that steals the throne for a long, long time"

All we can really do is hope that one day we make a game that can challenge the Super Meat Boy throne. Until then, arrivederci! (That’s Italian for good bye!)

notes.title: BBT Steam Version - Price Announced
notes.notes:
Howdy, y'all!

If you didn't keep up with PAX East news last weekend, then you may have missed the news that BattleBlock Theater Steam will be coming out at $14.99 USD once it's released. We just did a recap of all our PAX East 2014 announcements HERE.

After two weeks of rigorous beta testing, we’ve determined that we are in fact developing a game! In true Behemoth fashion we have no current release date, BUT…we know the price. $14.99 US Dollars! Did we mention we’ll be coming to Steam for Windows first, with Linux later this year? Not yet? Well there it is! Lots to celebrate and look forward to.

We'll keep you in the loop about BattleBlock Theater Steam. Thanks to all the fans who stopped by our booth at PAX East!
